name: David Starr
bio:
David Starr has spent almost 25 years focused entirely on architecting Apple solutions for business, enterprise, and education organizations. David was a Consulting Engineer manager at Apple in the US, and he later co-founded Black Glove, a managed services provider dedicated to delivering scalable Apple-centric IT services. Today, David leads Partners @ Workbrew helping bring Workbrew’s secure software delivery platform to organizations around the world.

David is based in The Hague, Netherlands. When not working, he enjoys traveling the world with his family and playing guitar, bass, and piano.
